_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Contractor Performance/Training Device Performance Report
summary: This DID defines the format, content, and intended use of the Contractor Performance/Training Device Performance Report, covering personnel, manpower, trainer, and maintenance data for training devices.
use_relationship:
This document defines the requirements to complete the Contractor Performance / Training Device Performance Report.

This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data product resulting from the work task described in the contract SOW.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: Contractor Performance/Training Device Performance Report shall be delivered in table format. Identified in figure samples found within this Data Item Description.

children.title: Part I - Performance Report Summary:
children.content: The report shall contain information relative to personnel, manpower distribution, work accomplished, and any problem areas encountered for each training device or Contract Line Item. Data elements not applicable to a specific device/equipment item shall be marked "NA" or "0" as appropriate. Data elements are as follows (see Example for Performance Report Summary):

children.title: To:
children.content: Address in accordance with the contract.

children.title: From:
children.content: Name of Contractor providing services.

children.title: Title:
children.content: "Monthly Contractor Performance Report."

children.title: Block 1. Device/Equipment Nomenclature:
children.content: Identify the end item which is the subject of the report (e.g., WTT, OFT, VMT, FMST, EC).

children.title: Block 2. Report Date:
children.content: Identify the date the report is completed.

children.title: Block 3. Device/Equipment Number:
children.content: Identify the alphanumeric training device/equipment designation number and serial number, if assigned (e.g., S48R-01).

children.title: Block 4. Contract / Task Order Number:
children.content: Self-explanatory.

children.title: Block 5. Contract Period of Performance:
children.content: Identify the start and end dates of the contract Period of Performance.

children.title: Block 6. Reporting Period:
children.content: Identify the beginning and end dates of the period covered by the report.

children.title: Block 7. Personnel Time Distribution:
children.content: Identify the time distribution, to the nearest half-hour, of all contractor personnel performing work on the device reported for the following tasks:

children.title: Block 8. Trainer Down Time:
children.content: Identify the number of hours, to the nearest tenth of an hour, the end item was down (not mission capable) and unavailable for training. Downtime hours shall be subcategorized as follows:

children.title: Block 9. Summary of Work Accomplished:
children.content: Include a narrative description of work performed during the reporting period for:

children.title: Operations, Maintenance, Information Assurance, Supply Support, Mobilization/Transition Status:
children.content: Provide a description of work accomplished and status, citing any problem areas encountered. Describe all periods of downtime (item 12 above). List the quantity of maintenance actions opened, closed, and ongoing for the period. Provide a summary of Information Assurance (IA) work performed during the period, listing all patches installed if applicable.

children.title: Modifications:
children.content: Describe all Government-approved changes the contractor made to the device configuration. Where Government personnel or another Government contractor performs modifications, those modifications shall be briefly described and the performing activity identified.

children.title: Training:
children.content: Describe the nature and extent of training provided by the contractor to its own personnel, or by the Government or another Government contractor, to on-site personnel. Mobilization training status shall be addressed during the mobilization period.

children.title: Premium Time (PT) Status/Utilization:
children.content: List the amount of PT utilized during the reporting period and cumulative for the Period of Performance. Detailed information shall be entered on a Premium Time (PT) Addendum (Refer to Figure for a sample of Premium Time Addendum Report).

children.title: Technical Data Verification Status/Utilization:
children.content: List the status and amount of documentation verified during the reporting period. Detailed information shall be entered on the Technical Data Verification (TDV) Addendum Report (Refer to Example for a sample of Technical Data Verification Report).

children.title: Signatures:
children.content: The report shall be signed and dated by the Contractor's Site Manager and by the COR/Government POC. Signature authority may be delegated to a designated Technical Point of Contact (TPOC) in writing by the COR/Government POC when applicable. The signature authority may add remarks to the reports at their discretion.

children.title: Classification of Reports:
children.content: The reports shall be unclassified.

children.title: Part II Trainer/Equipment Performance Summary
children.content:
See Sample Trainer/Equipment Performance Summary Report. Figure 2
The following data shall be included:

children.title: Contract/Task Order #:
children.content: Identify the Contract/Task order number.

children.title: Device/Equipment:
children.content: Identify the end item which is the subject of the report (e.g., OFT, WTT, MST, VMT, EC).

children.title: Reporting Period:
children.content: Identify the beginning and ending dates of the period covered by the report using MMDDYY format.

children.title: Contracted Training Time (CTT):
children.content: The total time during the reporting period that the training device is contracted to be available for training. Determined by summing up the CTT hours as specified in the contract for all working days of the reporting period, plus training premium time and/or make-up training time.

children.title: Contracted Training Time Utilized (CTTU):
children.content: The "actual" portion of contracted training time during which training occurs.

children.title: Scheduled Training Time (STT):
children.content: Enter the total training hours scheduled by the scheduling authority for the reporting period.

children.title: Non-Chargeable Down Time (NCDT):
children.content: That portion of total downtime for which the contractor is not held responsible. The COR will make the final determination of whether downtime is non-chargeable.

children.title: Chargeable Down Time (CDT):
children.content: That portion of total downtime attributable to the failure of the contractor to provide systems capable of being used for training, such that training was either postponed, canceled, or materially degraded. The COR will make the final site determination of whether downtime is chargeable.

children.title: Partial Mission Capability Quantity (PMCQ):
children.content: That portion of CTT in which the device is used in a degraded status. The product of Partial Mission Capability Factor (PMCF) multiplied by Partial Mission Capability Time (PMCT). The COR will make the final site determination of whether training time is degraded and by what percent.

children.title: Hours Lost to Cancellations:
children.content: Enter the number of scheduled training-time hours lost during the reporting period due to student no-shows or other scheduling authority cancellations. When an alternate event (i.e., a replacement event) is conducted during this period, do not count as lost hours.

children.title: Number of Restarts/Reboots:
children.content: Number of incidents training is interrupted due to computer (host or subsystem) restarts/reboots (example: 0/5). Restarts (resets) involve simple resetting of the device back to original mission conditions at the IOS, whereas a reboot requires computer system/subsystem re-initialization of the software.

children.title: Utilization of Availability (UA):
children.content: The quotient expressed by dividing CTTU (data element 2.2.f) by CTT (data element 2.2.e). The quotient shall be expressed as a percentage to the nearest tenth of a percent.

children.title: Cumulative Contracted Training Time (CCTT):
children.content: The cumulative sum of all CTT (data element 3) for the LOT.

children.title: Cumulative Contracted Training Time Utilized (CCTTU):
children.content: The cumulative sum of all CTTU (data element 4) for the LOT.

children.title: Cumulative Utilization of Availability:
children.content: The quotient expressed by dividing the CCTTU (data element 13) by the CCTT (data element 12). The quotient shall be expressed as a percentage to the nearest tenth of a percent.

children.title: Contractor Performance Factor (CPF):
children.content: A percentage calculated in accordance with the CPF formula specified in the contract. CPF shall be expressed as a percentage to the nearest tenth of a percent.

children.title: Cumulative CPF:
children.content: A percentage calculated in accordance with the CPF formula specified in the contract, utilizing the cumulative individual values of the elements of the formula's numerator and denominator. Such accumulation shall be over the current Government fiscal year reporting periods, expressed as a percentage to the nearest tenth of a percent.

children.title: Cumulative Restarts and Reboots:
children.content: The cumulative sum of all the restarts and reboots (data element 10) for the LOT.

children.title: Part III - CMS/CFM Hardware Equipment Group Performance Summary
children.content:
Contractor Maintenance Services (CMS)/Contractor Maintenance Factor Report (CFM)
CMS/CFM Hardware Equipment Group Performance Summary See Figure 3. The following data elements shall be included for all devices/equipment supported by CMS:

children.title: Contract No./Task Number:
children.content: Self-explanatory.

children.title: Equipment Group:
children.content: A grouping of hardware equipment under CMS whose aggregate average monthly contractor measurement factor (AMCMF) is associated with an individual contract line item or task.

children.title: Report Period:
children.content: Enter the start and end date of the period covered by the report using MMDDYY format.

children.title: Signature Site Manager:
children.content: Enter Site Manager signature and Date.

children.title: Signature COR:
children.content: Enter COR signature and Date.

children.title: Hardware Equipment Nomenclature:
children.content: Identify the equipment by manufacturer's nomenclature.

children.title: Model Number:
children.content: Self-explanatory.

children.title: Serial Number:
children.content: Identify the equipment's serial number.

children.title: Time to Repair:
children.content: Time lapses from when the Government notifies the Contractor of the requirement for repair or maintenance action to the time the hardware item is delivered to the Government in operational condition. Note: If so, specified in individual task orders, Hours to Repair may only apply to specified equipment under Maintenance Support Hours (MSH).

children.title: Contractor Measurement Factor (CMF):
children.content: The measure of the Contractor's success in meeting the Government's operational requirements for CMS-supported hardware. CMF is computed in accordance with the contract.

children.title: Total:
children.content: The total of hardware CMF for the reporting period.

children.title: Average Monthly Contractor Measurement Factor (AMCMF):
children.content: The tangible measure of the Contractor's success in meeting the Government's operational requirements for an equipment group. AMCMF is computed in accordance with the contract. Note: A grouping of hardware equipment under CMS whose aggregate AMCMF is associated with an individual contract line item.

children.title: Part IV - Trainer Support Effectiveness Report
children.content: Trainer Support Effectiveness Report See Figure 4 Sheets 1 and 2. The report shall contain information on all maintenance actions relative to each device/equipment item and the status of inventory/inventory shortages for each device/equipment. Data elements not applicable to a specific device/equipment item shall be marked "NA" for alphanumeric fields and "0" (zero) for numeric fields. Data elements to be addressed are as follows, in the order shown:

children.title: Contractor Site Manager's and COR/Government POC's Signatures, Dates Signed:
children.content: Self-explanatory.

children.title: COR/Government POC Remarks:
children.content: Self-explanatory.

children.title: Contract Number/Task Order Number:
children.content: Self-explanatory.

children.title: Site Location/Command:
children.content: Self-explanatory.

children.title: Contract Support/Report Period:
children.content: Enter the start and ending date of the period covered by the report using MMDDYY format.

children.title: Service Action Data:
children.content: For each device/equipment serviced, provide a list of chargeable hours for repair for each maintenance action completed during the reporting period. Annotate the highest level of maintenance required to accomplish the repair (O, I, D).

children.title: Outstanding Maintenance Actions:
children.content: List all pending maintenance actions, as of the close of the reporting period, along with the following information:

children.title: Device/Equipment:
children.content: Identify the training device/equipment designation number assigned to the end item, and the serial or BUNO #. If the device/equipment does not have a device number, enter the device/equipment name.

children.title: Maintenance Action Document/MAF Number:
children.content: Provide the unique identifier for the maintenance action.

children.title: Date Initiated:
children.content: Specify the date the maintenance action was initiated.

children.title: Expected Date of Completion:
children.content: Provide the anticipated completion date for the maintenance action.

children.title: Parts on Order to Complete Repair:
children.content: List any parts ordered to complete the repair.

children.title: Level of Maintenance:
children.content: Indicate the highest level of maintenance required (O, I, D).

children.title: Remarks:
children.content: Include a discrepancy summary and the course of action to correct the issue.

children.title: Maintenance Time Accrual:
children.content: Reports the total quantity of maintenance hours expended on each completed maintenance action for Preventive Maintenance and Corrective Maintenance ("O", "I", or "D" Level). The following data elements apply:

children.title: Device/Equipment:
children.content: Identify the training device/equipment designation number assigned to the end item, and the serial or BUNO #. If the device/equipment does not have a device number, enter the device/equipment name.

children.title: Maintenance Action Document/MAF Number:
children.content: Provide the unique identifier for the maintenance action.

children.title: Date Initiated:
children.content: Specify the date the maintenance action was initiated.

children.title: Preventive Maintenance Hours:
children.content: Report the total hours spent on preventive maintenance.

children.title: Corrective Maintenance Hours:
children.content: Report on the total hours spent on corrective maintenance.

children.title: Elapsed Maintenance Time:
children.content: Provide the total time elapsed for the maintenance action.

children.title: Information Assurance (IA) Hours:
children.content: Report on the hours spent on Information Assurance tasks.

children.title: Remarks:
children.content: Include a discrepancy summary and the course of action to correct the issue.

children.title: Inventory Shortages:
children.content: List of any GFP/GFI inventory shortages outstanding as of the end of the reporting period. The following data elements apply:

children.title: Device/Equipment:
children.content: Identify the training device/equipment designation number assigned to the end item, and the serial or BUNO #. If the device/equipment does not have a device number, enter the device/equipment name.

children.title: Nomenclature:
children.content: Provide the name or description of the item.

children.title: Part Number:
children.content: If different from the nomenclature, provide the part number.

children.title: National Stock Number:
children.content: If applicable, provide NSN.

children.title: Tracking Number:
children.content: Identify the Contractor's MAF or tracking number associated with the resolution of the inventory shortage.

children.title: Government Issued Inventory Quantity:
children.content: Specify the quantity issued by the Government.

children.title: Quantity Missing from Inventory:
children.content: Report the quantity missing from inventory.

children.title: Unit Cost Per Item:
children.content: Provide the cost per item in U.S. dollars.

children.title: Date Item Ordered:
children.content: Specify the date the item was ordered.

children.title: Expected Delivery Date:
children.content: Provide the anticipated delivery date.

children.title: Remarks:
children.content: Include any relevant comments or additional details.

children.title: Inventory Usage:
children.content: List all inventory usage items and activity. Specify in columnar format. State in Remarks specific to higher-profile items such as:

children.title: Consumables such as common screws, grease, resistors, etc., do not require reporting.
Device/Equipment:
children.content: Identify the training device/equipment designation number assigned to the end item, and the serial or BUNO #. If the device/equipment does not have a device number, enter the device/equipment name.

children.title: Nomenclature:
children.content: Provide the name or description of the item.

children.title: Brief Description of Failure:
children.content: Include a short description of the failure.

children.title: MAF Number:
children.content: Provide the unique identifier for the maintenance action.

children.title: Manufacturer's Part Number:
children.content: Specify the part number assigned by the manufacturer.

children.title: National Stock Number:
children.content: If applicable, provide NSN.

children.title: Government Issued Inventory Quantity:
children.content: Specify the quantity issued by the Government.

children.title: Unit Repair/Replacement Cost Per Item:
children.content: Provide the cost per item in U.S. dollars.

children.title: Date Ordered/Sent Out for Repair:
children.content: Specify the date the item was ordered or sent out for repair.

children.title: Expected Delivery Date:
children.content: Provide the anticipated delivery date.

children.title: Comments:
children.content: Include any relevant remarks or additional details.

children.title: Part V Contractor Personnel
children.content: Contractor Personnel: (See figure 5) list all currently employed on-site contractor personnel by name and Department of Labor category associated with this contract (e.g., Electronics Technician, Maintenance III). Describe position assignment and/or nature and date of any change in employment status of contractor personnel. Identify Government-accepted qualification specialties (i.e., site manager, shift supervisor, V tech, IA Level I tech), any special qualifications/training that is required, and date qualified (MMDDYY). Indicate Department of Labor designation anniversary date (MMDDYY). Example: H. Smith (Full-Time); DOL Code 23183/Electronics Technician, Maintenance III/ "Visual" Tech/ "BARCO" Tech; hired as Tech II 01/01/2021 and promoted to Tech III 09/01/2021; BARCO Level III certified 11/01/2021. DOL Anniversary Date: 09/2021.
